title: Witch Demands Manager
description: A skeletal witch with long purple hair and a pointed hat leans over a customer service desk, pointing accusingly at a tired female employee while holding a keyboard. The office is filled with floating letters, chains, receipts, and a service bell, with a blood-red moon visible through a window displaying 'THIS IS IT'.
prompt: A skeletal witch with flowing purple hair and a pointed hat angrily confronts a bored female employee at a service desk, pointing with one hand while holding a keyboard in the other. Floating letters, chains, and receipts fill the air. A service bell and paperwork sit on the counter. Through a window a glowing red moon is visible with text 'THIS IS IT'. Dark fantasy office horror scene with dramatic lighting.
